diagnostics.message: `:resource.google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service` associates this project with Shared VPC but has no dependency on `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`; enabling the Compute API first avoids attempting the association before the API is ready.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.google_kms_crypto_key_iam_member.service_identity_cmek` to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services` is already guaranteed through its dependencies on the BigQuery/Storage service-account data sources and `:resource.google_project_service_identity.jit_si`, each of which depends on the project services.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.google_project_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots` to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services` is transitively guaranteed through its dependencies on the service identity resources, default service accounts, and service-account data sources.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.google_compute_subnetwork_iam_member.shared_vpc_host_robots` to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services` is transitively guaranteed through its dependencies on the service identity resources, default service accounts, and service-account data sources.

The explicit dependency from `:resource.google_logging_project_sink.sink` to `:resource.google_project_service.project_services` is already guaranteed through its dependencies on the IAM binding/member resources, which themselves depend on the project services.

`:resource.google_compute_shared_vpc_service_project.shared_vpc_service` enables Shared VPC for this project but does not wait for `:resource.google_project_service.project_services`; the sibling Shared VPC host configuration explicitly waits for project services. Add an explicit dependency so the Compute API is enabled before this association is attempted.
